Text: The Journey of Faith
Heading: A Spiral, Not a Ladder
Text: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We return to familiar questions from …
blocks.value: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We return to familiar questions from deeper places, carrying new experience, grief, insight, and grace. No stage is a rank, and no stage makes anyone more loved by God.

blocks.label: Text: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change—not God's r…
blocks.value: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change—not God's relationship to us. Jesus remains at the center of the journey.

Text: Where You Are
Heading: This is holy, generative work.
Text: You are actively looking—reading, praying differently, and exploring pra…
blocks.value: You are actively looking—reading, praying differently, and exploring practices and voices you were not handed. Something in you has refused tidy answers and set out to find what is real. That takes courage.

blocks.label: Text: What feels like leaving faith behind may also be faith becoming more hon…
blocks.value: What feels like leaving faith behind may also be faith becoming more honest. The questions that once felt only painful are beginning to function as a compass. You are not trying to return to certainty. You are learning to seek God with open hands.

blocks.label: Text: One common risk in this season is endless searching: moving from voice t…
blocks.value: One common risk in this season is endless searching: moving from voice to voice without letting anything deepen. Seekers need what the internet cannot provide—companions, practices, and roots. The way of Jesus and the contemplative tradition offer a center spacious enough for real questions.

blocks.label: Heading: Your questions may be a form of faithfulness.
blocks.value: Your questions may be a form of faithfulness.

blocks.label: Text: Honest doubt does not necessarily mean you have abandoned faith. It may …
blocks.value: Honest doubt does not necessarily mean you have abandoned faith. It may mean you care too deeply about what is true to settle for answers that no longer hold.

blocks.label: Heading: Seeking is not the same as being lost.
blocks.value: Seeking is not the same as being lost.

blocks.label: Text: The travelers on the road to Emmaus did not recognize Jesus at first—but…
blocks.value: The travelers on the road to Emmaus did not recognize Jesus at first—but he was walking with them the whole way.

blocks.label: Heading: You do not have to search alone.
blocks.value: You do not have to search alone.

blocks.label: Text: This season can be tempted toward isolation, and it is often helped most…
blocks.value: This season can be tempted toward isolation, and it is often helped most by a table of honest people.

blocks.label: Heading: Practice steadies the search.
Text: When belief feels unsettled, a simple rhythm of prayer and silence can k…
blocks.value: When belief feels unsettled, a simple rhythm of prayer and silence can keep you tethered to God, not only to your thoughts about God.

blocks.label: Text: A Practice for This Season
Heading: Breath Prayer
Text: Coming home to God, one breath at a time. Breath prayer pairs a few hone…
blocks.value: Coming home to God, one breath at a time. Breath prayer pairs a few honest words with your breathing and lets them carry you back to God.

blocks.label: Heading: Settle
Text: Let your shoulders drop. Take one slow breath and remember that you are …
blocks.value: Let your shoulders drop. Take one slow breath and remember that you are already in God's presence. You are not summoning God—only noticing.

blocks.label: Heading: Choose
Text: Pick a pair of words. Breathe the first line in and the second line out,…
blocks.value: Pick a pair of words. Breathe the first line in and the second line out, slowly.

blocks.label: Heading: Return
Text: When your mind wanders—and it will—gently come back to the words. The wa…
blocks.value: When your mind wanders—and it will—gently come back to the words. The wandering is not failure. The returning is the prayer.

blocks.label: Heading: Carry It
Text: Take your phrase into the day: one breath at a red light, in a hard mome…
blocks.value: Take your phrase into the day: one breath at a red light, in a hard moment, or before a conversation.

Heading: Do Not Search Alone.
